claim.claim-text: 1. A method of performing machine learning operations for an autonomous vehicle, the method comprising:

2. The method as in claim 1, additionally comprising executing the computational workload using local compute resources of the autonomous vehicle in response to determining that the second latency is above the threshold associated with the computational workload and limiting autonomous functionality of the autonomous vehicle when executing the computational workload using local resources.
3. The method as in claim 1 or 2, wherein limiting autonomous functionality of the autonomous vehicle includes reducing a maximum autonomous travel seed for the autonomous vehicle.

4. The method as in any one of the preceding claims, wherein limiting autonomous functionality of the autonomous vehicle includes reducing speed at which the autonomous vehicle selects alternative routes based on dynamic traffic conditions.
5. A data processing system for an autonomous vehicle, the data processing system comprising means to perform a method as in any one of claims 1-4.

6. One or more machine-readable storage media storing instructions thereon that, when executed by a computing device, configure the computing device to perform a method according to any one of claims 1-4.
